overview: The Raccoons of the Tama Hills are being forced from their homes by the rapid development of houses and shopping malls. As it becomes harder to find food and shelter, they decide to band together and fight back. The Raccoons practice and perfect the ancient art of transformation until they are even able to appear as humans in hilarious circumstances.
title: Pom Poko

results.title: Eisen Flügel
results.original_title: アイゼンフリューゲル
results.overview: In a world where dragons rule the skies, mankind still dreams of flight, of someday dominating the heavens in their stead. Even in times of war, the passionate young pilot Karl Schuniz continues to chase his dreams, taking up his wings of steel - the revolutionary new aircraft, the Blitz Vogel - to challenge the Kaiser Drache, the fastest dragon that can fly at supersonic speeds.

results.title: Non Non Biyori Repeat OVA
results.original_title: のんのんびより りぴーと OAD
results.overview: An OVA bundled with the tenth manga volume.

results.title: The Golden Compass
results.overview: In a parallel universe, after overhearing a shocking secret, precocious orphan Lyra Belacqua trades her carefree existence roaming the halls of Jordan College for an otherworldly adventure in the far North, unaware that it's part of her destiny.

results.title: Prostokvashino
results.overview: A boy nicknamed Uncle Fyodor loved animals very much, but his parents didn't want to hear anything about having a pet in their apartment. So Uncle Fyodor had to move to the village of Prostokvashino with his new friends — the cat Matroskin and the faithful dog Sharik.

results.title: The Story of Heidi
results.original_title: アルプスの少女ハイジ
results.overview: Heidi is five years old when her aunt Dete, who has raised Heidi since her parents' deaths four years earlier, takes the orphaned Heidi to live with her formidable grandfather in the Swiss Alps. The American feature-length adaptation of Heidi (1974), the Japanese anime series produced by Zuiyo Eizo.

results.title: Fate/Grand Order Final Singularity – Grand Temple of Time: Solomon
results.original_title: Fate/Grand Order -終局特異点 冠位時間神殿ソロモン-
results.overview: After battling their way through all seven Singularities, the Chaldea Security Organization has finally arrived at the endpoint of the Grand Order: The Final Singularity, Grand Temple of Time: Solomon. Now is the time to defeat the root of all evil, Solomon, the King of Mages. Now is the time to reclaim the future. With the final operation looming large, Romani Archaman considers the choices he will soon have to make, Mash Kyrielight dwells on life's limitations, and Fujimaru prepares to receive a new Mystic Code. All their many encounters have led to this moment as Fujimaru and Mash at last embark on their final operation...

results.title: Mazinger Z: Infinity
results.original_title: 劇場版 マジンガーZ ／ INFINITY
results.overview: When the evil Dr. Hell attacks the Earth, the mighty giant mecha Mazinger Z is formed to stop him.

results.title: EVANGELION 30th Anniversary Special Screening
results.original_title: エヴァンゲリオン放送30周年記念特別興行
results.overview: A short film celebrating the 30th anniversary of Neon Genesis Evangelion starring both the original and Rebuild iterations of Asuka. The short comedically explores alternate timelines, with Rebuild Asuka helping her original counterpart make some wishes come true.

results.title: Undersea Super Train: Marine Express
results.original_title: 海底超特急 マリン・エクスプレス
results.overview: The plot of Marine Express can be described in two parts. The first part focuses on the people boarding the train and the problems they encounter on it. The second part takes place after the train has stopped at its half-way point, an island that used to be home to an ancient civilization millennia ago and has its fair share of secrets.

results.title: Doggie March
results.overview: It tells the story of Rock, a puppy whose mother is killed by a tiger and a fox. To fulfill his revenge, will achieve together a large number of animals. An animated collaboration between Osamu Tezuka and Toei Animation.

results.title: Evan Almighty
results.overview: God contacts Junior Congressman Evan Baxter and tells him to build an ark in preparation for a great flood.

results.title: Free!: Timeless Medley - The Bond
results.original_title: 劇場版 Free! -Timeless Medley- 絆
results.overview: A recap movie of mostly Eternal Summer with some of season one. Focuses on Haru and Iwatobi. Also includes never before seen scenes and includes cameos from High Speed characters.

results.title: A Teacher of Singing
results.overview: Hippo came to the teacher of singing, but all the efforts of the maestro do not help (neither hearing nor voice). It was necessary for the student to simply swallow the teacher, and he sang with a beautiful, alien voice.

results.title: The Horse Whisperer
results.overview: The mother of a severely traumatized daughter enlists the aid of a unique horse trainer to help the girl's equally injured horse.

results.title: Judgment! XX Angel Rabbie
results.original_title: 天罰エンジェルラビィ☆
results.overview: Humanity makes much progress through a combination of science and magic, until a large war breaks out. Many years later, the magical city of Sosarium (constructed on the Moon) sends an agent down to Earth to make sure history does not repeat itself as civilisation starts to rebuild itself. That agent is known as an Angel.

results.title: Jin-Roh: The Wolf Brigade
results.overview: A member of an elite paramilitary counter-terrorism unit becomes traumatized after witnessing the suicide bombing of a young girl and is forced to undergo retraining. However, unbeknownst to him, he becomes a key player in a dispute between rival police divisions, as he finds himself increasingly involved with the sister of the girl he saw die.

results.title: Skin and Mind
results.overview: A married couple, Yoon-hee(wife) and Seong-gye(husband) are bored with each other after getting married. A husband turned into a chicken, unwilling to tell his wife that he loved her. A domestic father who is old and turned into a deer with great horn. Everyone is changing. And finally, Yoon-hee finds herself changed, too.

results.title: Final Fantasy VII: Advent Children
results.overview: Two years have passed since the final battle with Sephiroth. Though Midgar, city of mako, city of prosperity, has been reduced to ruins, its people slowly but steadily walk the road to reconstruction. However, a mysterious illness called Geostigma torments them. With no cure in sight, it brings death to the afflicted, one after another, robbing the people of their fledgling hope.

results.title: Beyond Creation
results.overview: While drawing, Rui is surprised by the presence of Epsilon, a mysterious girl with magical powers.

results.title: Fantasia
results.overview: Walt Disney's timeless masterpiece is an extravaganza of sight and sound! See the music come to life, hear the pictures burst into song and experience the excitement that is Fantasia over and over again.
